name: Macon
gaps: Source query returned 5771 rows; 5757 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.

Parcels are Parcel_Polygon (MaconCapture — CaptureCAMA ArcGIS Server) (https://gis.capturecama.com/arcgis/rest/services/MaconAL/MaconCapture/MapServer/1). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
The card marks this public parcel layer partial. Attributes that are absent stay empty.
Property-appraiser links are stored from the card pattern and were not requested.
Owner phone and email are not ingested. ALDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
No owner / mailing / value / sale fields on public REST — join by PARCELID to CaptureCAMA HTML (not bulk)
Snapshot services on maps.capturecama.com are date-stamped and rotate; prefer gis.capturecama.com MaconCapture
